name: io.github.NAJEMWEHBE/unreal-ai-connection
title: Unreal AI Connection
description: PREREQUISITE: install the Unreal AI Connection UE 5.7 plugin into your UE project and launch the editor (it binds 127.0.0.1:18888) before connecting — no registry can do this for you. Then this stdio bridge exposes 104 Unreal Engine editor-automation tools (actors, sequencer, materials, assets, live viewport) to any MCP client.
